items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: It belonged to Rockefeller, you know -- that's who it actually belonged to. And I had one of Rockefeller's houses

ctx.x: Yeah, collector's items, different acts, different attractions that came on, different singers. We had a fellow here from Phoenix, Arizona, who was a bar tender, but he got together a good act, comedy. He could imitate anybody, and it was through him -- he recommended us, said we played his music better than anybody ever played it, so the management was

convinced we were good for the room. And, as I say -- then they gave me a house -- big house right on the estate. It belonged to Rockefeller, you know -- that's who it actually belonged to. And I had one of Rockefeller's houses, a big two-story mansion there. And my back yard was right on the golf course, and I could go out and practice golf every morning. Go out on the beach right down -- and my dogs had the run of the whole neighborhood and the woods. It was just beautiful there, beautiful life in Puerto Rico.
